recommendation: Keep the source change as-is. It is a narrow active-source correction that completes the published non-substantive wording request without changing the modifier-extension conformance semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-18351 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the FHIR-core extensibility page asking to change the old 'Other data types, or elements inside data types...' wording to a conjunctive subject and to make the extension-internal modifier-extension prohibition a separate sentence.
initial_application: The 2018 'Additional typos' commit 7bf7397f4a965784698e0d343f8a96789cdf4942 partially applied the issue by changing 'Other data types, or elements inside data types' to 'Other data types and elements inside data types', but it left the requested comma-and before the extension clause.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps extension=extensibility, so source/extensibility.html is active build source. Adjacent FHIR-18350 later corrected the preceding sentence in the same paragraph, and FHIR-25431 later standardized 'data type' to 'datatype', so the reconciliation preserves current terminology while completing FHIR-18351. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/extensibility.html so the rule now reads 'Other datatypes and elements inside datatypes SHALL NOT have modifier extensions.' followed by 'Extensions SHALL NOT have modifier extensions internally...'.
source_changes: source/extensibility.html: split the modifier-extension datatype prohibition and extension-internal prohibition into two sentences while preserving later 'datatype' terminology.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent N-Infra correction to the preceding modifier-extension sentence and list punctuation in the same paragraph.
Later terminology cleanup standardized 'data type' to 'datatype' in this paragraph, which this reconciliation preserved.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction requesting the extensibility page change 'or' to 'and' and split the extension-internal modifier-extension rule into its own sentence.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent for a non-substantive wording correction on the FHIR-core extensibility page.

evidence_items.summary: Before reconciliation the current paragraph had 'Other datatypes and elements inside datatypes' but still joined the next clause with ', and extensions SHALL NOT...'.
evidence_items.learned: The source retained an incomplete form of the requested FHIR-18351 sentence cleanup.
The edited extensibility page is active in the current build surface for the Extension datatype page.

evidence_items.learned: Historical application captured the conjunctive-subject correction but did not split the extension clause into a separate sentence.

evidence_items.summary: The 2022 FHIR-25431 commit changed 'data type' to 'datatype' in this paragraph.
evidence_items.learned: The current 'datatypes' spelling is a later intentional terminology decision and should be preserved.
